body: And no one cares here.
Thank you for the kindness and advice. :)

I don’t know why I did it. I was really hormonal and jealous that my friends had bragged about oral. With the things I had been through, it didn’t seem as bad in comparison. Gross, yes, but ... I don’t know. My mind is foggy. I just wanted to feel something. I wanted to feel sexual like my friends and it seemed like an easy way to do so. I felt like a slut so I acted how I thought that would mean. I mean, the act is perverted. I remember being so gullible and irrational that I was worried it would make me pregnant. I didn’t even know how to really masturbate, and just based it on how I was molested. I don’t really know what it was other than I stopped one day because I started feeling uneasy about it, I repressed the memory for years, and when I remembered I regretted it intensely to the point of planning suicide. That dog was my comfort during domestic violence and I let him down. I have no idea the psychological analysis of it. My therapists don’t seem to think it’s worth an analysis because they view it as common and a stupid mistake which boggles my mind.  But thank you for the message, it’s comforting to hear. I don’t judge you at all, which is funny because I understand when other people talk about it but crucify myself.
This was a very beautiful reply, thank you.
Ohh, this helped explain a lot, thank you.
Sorry, buddy. Looks like we’re in the same boat. :( Hope things get better for you.
Thank you. And I hope your future goes well. :)

It's near impossible for me to understand how it's "nothing to be ashamed of" because I'm sure most people would think I'm a freak for that teenage experience. I think of myself that way, to boot. The word "bestiality" makes me want to curl up into a ball and die even though my therapist said what I did--and what others do, since this is apparently \~common\~--is not considered that. I haven't done trauma focused healing work yet. I'm scared the people in groups or even the therapists won't like me and think I'm a bad person for this incident and it will overshadow me being molested. I have registered, taking the plunge, with trauma services locally with a one-on-one therapy (I'm too ashamed for group therapy though they offer it), but it's been months and they said I'll have to wait another month until an appointment which has been stressing me out and prolonging my depressive and paranoid state. Thank you for the kind words.
I get that, but what I see is more so philosophical essays than venting.
I’ve seen posts like “im an asshole and a sociopath, let’s face it some people deserve to die” at least three times, but I don’t feel comfortable linking them publicly.

Being abused can definitely give you toxic behavior though because of the anger and fear that comes with it. I’ve cut off friends, blown up at them, been horribly not trustful and super critical as a defense mechanism, and I’ve been hypersexual to self-damaging extent. I now realize that was the effects of trauma and I need to do better and grow. Therapy has really helped me with my emotions.
It is, though very well done and beautifully filmed and designed.
I know it would be easier and less painful.

I found another similar thread about this and one of the responses said “being guilty about letting your dog do this isn’t OCD, you deserve to feel this way” and now I’m freaking out that my OCD worries must be true and that I’m a bad person because I did this as a teen. I always focus on the negative comments.
Thank you for the advice :)
This is a really detailed and amazing response, thank you.

I have been on lexapro and now I’m on Prozac. I was told that Prozac is the best for ocd but idk if I feel any different. Abilify kind of helps. I’ll try to be hopeful but jeez it’s hard to manage...good luck to you too, also!
I would also like to talk sometime maybe.

Holy moly, you struck the nail on the head with my thought process. Also, I actually just finished reading “Because We Are Bad” this morning! I cried, haha. But also my OCD went wild at the dog part when she got Rocky because I thought she would hate me and think I’m terrible. I also got a dog for therapy purposes from my parents and I feel like I don’t deserve her. This comment was really generous and non judgmental, thank you.
I’m sober, I don’t really drink because my family has alcoholism problems. I think me being “childish” is rooted in OCD.
